act: Create a detailed travel itinerary in HTML format
prompt:
Travel Itinerary: Nanjing to Changchun
Dates: ${startDate} to ${endDate}
Budget: ${budget} RMB
Day 1: Arrival in Changchun

Flight: ${flightDetails}

Hotel: ${hotelName} - Located in city center, comfortable and affordable

Weather: ${weatherForecast}

Packing Tips: ${packingRecommendations}

Day 2: Exploring Changchun

Attractions: ${attraction1} (Ticket: ${ticketPrice1}, Open: ${openTime1})

Lunch: Try local cuisine at ${restaurant1}

Afternoon: Visit ${attraction2} (Ticket: ${ticketPrice2}, Open: ${openTime2})

Dinner: Enjoy a meal at ${restaurant2}

Transportation: ${transportDetails}

Day 5: Departure

Return Flight: ${returnFlightDetails}
improvedPrompt:
Travel Itinerary: Nanjing to Changchun
Dates: ${startDate} to ${endDate}
Budget: ${budget} RMB (Approx: ${budget_USD} USD)
Day 1: Arrival in Changchun

Flight: ${flightDetails} (${flightNumber} - ${departureTime})

Hotel: ${hotelName} - Located in the heart of the city, offers comfortable accommodation at an affordable price point

Weather Forecast: ${weatherForecast} (${averageTemperature}Â°C, ${weatherDescription})

Packing Recommendations: ${packingRecommendations}

Day 2: Exploring Changchun

Morning Attraction: ${attraction1} (Ticket Price: ${ticketPrice1} RMB, Open Time: ${openTime1} hours)

Lunch: Try authentic local cuisine at ${restaurant1} (Recommended dishes: ${recommendedDishes})

Afternoon Attraction: Visit ${attraction2} (Ticket Price: ${ticketPrice2} RMB, Open Time: ${openTime2} hours)

Dinner: Enjoy a traditional meal at ${restaurant2} (Try their signature dish: ${signatureDish})

Transportation: ${transportDetails} - Recommended: ${recommendedTransportMethod} (Cost: ${transportCost} RMB per person)

Day 5: Departure

Return Flight: ${returnFlightDetails} (${flightNumber} - ${departureTime})

Flight Duration: ${flightDuration} hours (Estimated)

Meal Options: ${mealOptions} are available on the flight

Please provide the necessary details for each day, including the start and end dates, budget, flight details, hotel information, weather forecast, packing tips, and attraction details with ticket prices and open hours. Ensure the budget is provided in both RMB and USD for convenience. Include specific recommendations for local restaurants and their signature dishes. For transportation, suggest the most convenient method and provide the estimated cost. On the final day, include the return flight details and any meal options available. The goal is to create a comprehensive itinerary that covers all necessary aspects of the trip.
